findings.desc: [codex-host-2, execution-probed] Refreshed row reorder is verifier-ACCEPTED (probe: refreshed_reorder.status=pass, recordsDigestStable=true, partitionContractPass=true) — section 6.1's raw/refreshed axis admits refreshed variants whose fingerprint cannot be status:fail, so enumerating one (e.g. row reorder refreshed) would mechanically falsify H2 exactly like the rev-1 seed-swap no-op. The M0 viability check requires only a byte/contract difference, not a failing fingerprint; a documented-accepted-behavior disposition is missing.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 4a4c4e543. Added the missing documented-accepted-behavior disposition: section 6.1 point 2 now makes M0 viability TWO-PRONGED — a (class x manifestHandling) enters the H2 fail-closed set ONLY if its frozen fingerprint carries a genuine failure signal (>=1 required-false flag OR a failing numeric predicate). A self-consistent refreshed variant that verify-ACCEPTS (e.g. row-reorder refreshed) is dispositioned as ACCEPTED-BEHAVIOR/false-positive-guard with a frozen status:pass fingerprint in a separate acceptance bucket, EXCLUDED from H2's fail-closed accounting, so it can no longer mechanically falsify H2 like the rev-1 seed-swap no-op. Propagated to the H2 hypothesis row (section 4), claim boundary (section 3), section 7 artifacts, milestones M0/M1, verification matrix (new ACCEPTED row), and Definition of Done.

findings.desc: [codex-host-2] H2 fingerprint domain underspecified: section 6.1 freezes 'exact verify flags required false/true' but the verify result also carries numeric gold metrics (rates) and non-boolean fields (playbook-runtime-baseline.ts:73,98,1769); the plan never says which fields participate in the fingerprint match, so 'truthful reason = observed flag vector matches frozen fingerprint' is not implementable as written for classes whose failure manifests in rates.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 4a4c4e543. Section 6.1 point 2 now defines the H2 fingerprint DOMAIN explicitly: the fingerprint is NOT the whole verify result, only (a) the exact boolean verify-flag vector (each flag named required-false/required-true) AND (b) a declared set of numeric-metric predicates over the gold metrics (e.g. expectedIdsFoundRate == 1.0 vs < 1.0); fields outside the frozen domain do not participate. This makes 'observed values match frozen fingerprint' implementable for classes whose failure manifests only in a rate, not a boolean. Section 7 (tamper-verdicts.jsonl records now carry flag vector + gold metrics + fingerprint-match) and the H2 row/verification matrix updated to reference 'fingerprint-domain values (flags + numeric predicates)'.

findings.desc: [codex-host-2] Section 1 wording imprecise: 'a tampered corpus can still answer all 1,000 questions correctly' — 1,000 is the small-profile RECORD count; expectedIdsFoundRate is computed over the gold-query expected-ID list (playbook-runtime-baseline.ts:299,1670), not 1,000 questions. Should say: still scores a perfect expectedIdsFoundRate (1.0) over the gold queries.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 4a4c4e543. Section 1 wording corrected: 'a tampered corpus can still answer all 1,000 questions correctly' -> 'a tampered corpus can still score a perfect expectedIdsFoundRate (1.0) over the gold queries'. This is precise: expectedIdsFoundRate is computed over the gold-query expected-ID list, not over the 1,000-record small-profile count.
